headline: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production, shift to Cybercab
summary: Tesla will stop building the Cybertruck, with the Texas factory space repurposed for the Cybercab robotaxi. Days later, Elon Musk defended the decision and said Tesla would refund some customer deposits. Outlets differ on tone: some call the Cybertruck a commercial failure, while others describe the shift neutrally.
